what_was_tested: Whether the untracked Nemotron-H SSM implementation in src/deep2 (NemotronHGeometry.hpp and friends) applies to the Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B blob exposed at F:\models\nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b.gguf.
method: Read the real block-0 SSM tensor dimensions from the GGUF, then applied the derivation formulae transcribed from NemotronHGeometry.hpp ResolveFromLayer, and evaluated its own acceptance gate NEMOTRON_H_REAL_SSM_001.
corroborating_evidence: ssm_norm.weight is [512, 8]. With 8 groups and the real inner size 4096, 4096 / 8 = 512, which is exactly the first dimension. The code instead expects inner 7680, which would imply 7680 / 8 = 960, not 512. The tensor shape corroborates the derived geometry rather than the expected one.

interpretation.the_code_targets_a_different_variant: NemotronHSsmArm.hpp and NemotronHMamba2Step.hpp are written for a larger Nemotron-H geometry: 96 heads, head dim 80, inner 7680, conv dim 9728, input rows 17504. Those numbers do not describe the blob on this machine.
interpretation.consequence_for_this_blob: ResolveFromLayer would return ok = 0, so SsmNemotronComplete and RunMamba2Token would refuse to run on these weights. The existing SSM arm cannot execute this model.
interpretation.not_a_code_defect: This is not a bug in that implementation. It is a variant mismatch. The two are not interchangeable.

state_of_the_untracked_nemotron_work.self_declared_status: The header comment on NemotronHMamba2Step.hpp states PROD_DECODE=0, and it emits SSM_NUMERIC_FINITE plus PRODUCTION_DECODE_PATH=0. In other words it reports only that outputs are finite, not that they are correct.
state_of_the_untracked_nemotron_work.note: The reference counts above were produced by searching the working tree for each filename, so they count the headers referencing each other and nothing more. No test exercises RunMamba2Token.

what_this_does_not_claim: No Nemotron tensor values were evaluated.
No claim that the SSM arithmetic in NemotronHMamba2Step.hpp is correct or incorrect. It was not executed and is not testable on this blob because its geometry gate fails first.
consequence_for_the_tps_blueprint: Three separate blockers now stack on the Nemotron 30B target: the architecture is nemotron_h_moe and is not implemented, the existing SSM arm targets a different geometry and would refuse these weights, and the arm is not wired into production decode or verified against a reference. The 128.78 TPS baseline and 643.90 TPS goal remain unreachable as a performance task on this codebase.
